title: What's your favorite food?
sentences: Oh pizza, that's cool! Why do you like it so much?
Because it's warm and cheesy, it just makes me really happy!
That's nice! Have you always liked pizza?
Yes, ever since I was a little kid.
Wow, that's a long time! Do you remember the first time you ate pizza?
I don't remember it, but I know I liked it right away.
Nice! What other food do you like?
Oh yeah, spaghetti is good too. And what do you like about it?
It's fun to twirl on my fork and I love the sauce. What do you actually like?
I like chicken nuggets and fries.
Yeah, those are good too. And do you like to drink something with your food?
I'll have a cola with dinner.
I don't drink anything when I eat. Because that's not healthy.
Oh, would you tell me more about that?
Yeah, that's fine. But another time. Now I'm going to cook something for you first.
Oh nice. Then I'll lie down on the couch for a bit.
